original_test_intent: Collect the complete UBB/SMC Redfish event-log set, find every CPER-linked diagnostic attachment, decode it and confirm under an approved policy that the collected evidence contains no error.
original_method: Capture source identity, Redfish schema, log boundary and live count/next-link metadata; enumerate LogServices, follow service-provided pagination to terminal completion with unique entry IDs, retrieve every referenced CPER attachment through protected read-only access, checksum and decode it using an approved compatible analyzer, then classify all entries and decoded records under the owner-defined error policy without clearing or acknowledging logs.
manual_activity: The owner approves endpoint/pagination/CPER/error semantics and analyzer; an operator reviews complete entries and decodes; the owner dispositions any error/abnormal event and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Protected Redfish LogServices/EventLog/Dump endpoint and schema
safety_requirements: Use read-only protected TLS/authenticated requests and redact secrets
Preserve all original logs; do not clear, rotate, delete or acknowledge
Follow live next links/count rather than sample count or fixed skips
Keep raw JSON and request errors separate; validate every HTTP/schema response
Require unique complete entry IDs and identity-bound timestamps
Checksum each CPER attachment before decoding with the approved tool
Stop on gaps, duplicates, identity mismatch, API/attachment/decode failure or error/abnormal event
agent_execution_scope: Collect identities, schema, log boundary and live pagination metadata
Retrieve and validate every log page and build a unique-entry manifest
Retrieve/checksum/decode every referenced CPER attachment with approved package
Classify events under supplied policy and report completeness/anomalies
Perform no severity-policy invention, log mutation, unsafe access, remediation or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint/schema, pagination termination, CPER mapping/analyzer and error policy
Review every error/critical/abnormal event and decoded CPER
Disposition incomplete or abnormal evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It reaches the first collection but does not paginate, validate members, retrieve or decode CPER, or apply error criteria; wc -l is not an event count and stderr contaminates the file.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected structured collector that follows live Redfish next links/counts, validates unique entries, retrieves/checksums all CPER attachments and decodes each with the approved analyzer while preserving raw evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LogServices, EventLog, CPER attachments/cdump_analyzer, no-error criterion, no bundle and 10/10-minute values remain; sample 5762/fixed skips are examples rather than authoritative live limits.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED COMPLETE EVENT AND CPER EVIDENCE GRAPH
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a collection manifest linking each page, unique event ID and CPER AdditionalDataURI to checksummed raw and decoded artifacts, then evaluate it against an approved severity policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses service-provided terminal pagination and artifact integrity instead of fixed skips and concatenated curl output while retaining every source-required diagnostic step.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: First-page-only collection can miss most events and all later CPER references, producing a false no-error result.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Logs may change during collection; a defined snapshot boundary, timestamps and deduplication are necessary, and decoder compatibility can block interpretation.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source asks to clear evidence, assumes a stale 5762 count and fixed $skip pages, uses insecure fixed HTTP/-k examples and leaves 'No show error' undefined. DeepSeek falsely labels a one-page line-count collection as complete, mixes stderr and omits CPER attachment/decode coverage.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2054 Wistron-AMD SVM-01065-V003: approve the protected LogServices/EventLog/Dump endpoint/schema, live pagination and collection-boundary semantics, CPER AdditionalDataURI attachment mapping, compatible cdump_analyzer version, evidence retention/redaction and the exact severity/error/abnormal policy behind 'No show error'.

review_improvement: Replaces a misleading first-page text count with a complete identity-bound event/attachment/decode manifest and an explicit owner-controlled no-error decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish collections are not complete merely because one response succeeds; live next-link/count termination and unique member IDs are required, especially while the log can grow. Text line count has no defined relation to JSON entry cardinality. A CPER reference is diagnostic metadata, not decoded evidence, so each attachment needs integrity verification and a compatible decoder. Because 'No show error' lacks severity and historical-event semantics, automation can enumerate facts but cannot own the final verdict.
